prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1125; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is undergoing ongoing medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative has spoken with our client, please note that we now handle all matters on her behalf.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and telematics, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and all communications with your insured or any witnesses. Written confirmation that these materials are being preserved would be appreciated within ten days of receipt of this letter.
